name: wordtoolkit
description: Token-lean native Microsoft Word automation with 13 core/gateway tools and lazy access to 56 native actions.

interface.longDescription: WordToolkit controls the real Microsoft Word application through one persistent native .NET COM STA thread. A small 13-tool MCP surface covers the common lifecycle and batch path; search, inspect and execute gateways load any of 56 native actions only when needed. Compact responses omit echoed input and diagnostics by default. The full action set covers saved-package graphs, semantics, sections, styles, modeled effective formatting and guarded text edits plus live formatting, Find/replace, review, tables, formulas, lists, bookmarks, fields, images, notes, headers/footers, editable Office Math, structures, layout, Undo, PDF and Open XML validation. The installed Word object model remains policy-gated; macros, DDE, unsafe raw COM paths and external effects fail closed. The package contains no Python runtime.
defaultPrompt: Open or connect to my Word document and edit it live.
Create a new Word document and write this content immediately.
Generate a long document in one fast native batch.
Add a step-by-step solution with native editable equations.
Add images, comments, footnotes, headers and footers, then export a PDF.
